title: I. Invocation (Nov 22, 2025)
content:
The cold wind knocked
And the mountain grumbled
The king arrived late with a stumble. In the west, a pound of flesh.
With no truth in its sights. Alaska, oh alaska. Where the storm meets the wind.

title: II. Horror (Dec 18, 2025)
content:
95 suspected and A Few Good Men were thrown into the river. The mountain groaned as the winds began to howl.
Voices broke the air, their shouts like whispers before the winds of The Storm.
The cloud had broken, The eye, deep in dusk, was on the horizon. In the east... lingering devastation.
The dust was red. They could not handle the truth.

title: III. Turning of the Year (Jan 1, 2026)
content:
Sol Invictus, the long night had finished. Each passing day a new counting towards a shorter a night.
The dusk had given way to the shadow of the earth, and the eye was closing.
Slowly, each of those who would stand to be counted would do so, against their own interest, for the pride their forefathers had laid to rest in the lingering east. The Storm had not stopped.
The Eye was over them now and the great wind had found it's way to the ocean.
The red dust had yet to settle.

title: IV. Globalization of the Storm (Jan 23, 2026)
content:
The Storm had come to northern Amazon, swiftly it carried through the streets an unloved king, leaving in its wake an endless mire to be bridged later.
So to had the Storm attempted the same to the Land of Green futures.
Those still in the lands of the ancient decried the new Chamberlain in remembrance of the old one’s passivity to the Great Red Storm of myth. The great winds in the fields to their east raged and must be put down, but a new storm from the west was not welcomed among them, for the Red Dust had not settled.
Not in the east. Nor in the forests south of west. Nor in deserts south of east. “Good” had gained meaning again, but the cost was death.
A Smith found his way to the tribunal of currents, his words, like hammer blows shaped the sword that would bring low the storm to be weighed upon the scales of justice. Many had feathers far too heavy. The rain was near, it could be smelt on the wind.

title: V. Elegy for the Named (Feb 13, 2026)
content:
The wind now wet with the humidity of fear and shame… the tears began to fall. 80,000 inside, 200 removed from the face of being. What did it mean to be “good” and proper?
Passive, civil, and “Pretti”?
Ever onward the technicians worked their sigils, strengthening their tower, leaving all to chance.
The philosopher king had long since left the world and left only a “space of relations” in its wake.
The abject evil that traveled by the storm, absorbed into the relations and mutated into the wellspring of the “other” land of the “free.” The world shaken by the revelations saw heads metaphorically roll, though the people longed to raise the physical blade that came after the land of balloons first threw its hat off. Those in the eye wished to be free of their “bondi”ge. “The Eye Like a Strange Balloon Mounts Toward Infinity”

title: VI. Death of The Thing (Mar 4, 2026)
content:
A final goodbye,
to the world that came before,
the dream that had existed where man could pretend his desires resided in some principle of The Thing. The weight of The Things body, Now revealed in the winds of the Second storm of Red Dust, brought upon us by the golden strands strung by the chamberlain of the storm. Compelled to dance the forms of rainfire, ever the instruments of our own destruction, driven by the ideals, in search of the Love for The Thing. Where was our pride? Our "Fury"? The people sat idly, struck by the audacity, the complicit twisted their principles and the advantage.
The eye of the storm had fallen over old Babylon.
and the red dust had risen in the land of the old gods. "thus spoke zarathustra"
we knocked on his door,
will zoroaster agree?
or will sargon answer the door? No man could know.
The Thing was dead now. Consumed by the storm.
The fish knew no god, and neither did we.

title: VII. War in the Gulf (Mar 30, 2026)
content:
The Red dust was gathering across the gulf of Sargon, The Storm had gathered in the black fields fortune. Expectations expected something to expect.
Their prophecy would be fulfilled. Screams. Raining Black Fire. The Cold Wind that once knocked against the mountains of Alaska to palaver with the Chamberlain raised its head. Considerations would be made. Demands would be eased. All the while, the men would be scattered like meat in a dog house before the unending vigilance of the new machines of the front. A new abstraction for the Tribunal of winds and storms. A Great new Hell for the sky above the trenches.
Palaver for peace? Still, there was no agreement. The Sly Bear of the Old East eyed the pressed sands of time, money, and logic that held up the world as it was in the time that came before the storm. But the Gulf of Sargon was still closed. The long winter was over.
And O'man, knew not what to do.

title: VIII. The Quiet Forging (Apr 2, 2026)
content:
The Gulf of Sargon remained barred, save for the chosen vessels of the Sly Bear.
hulking masses slipping through on whispered tribute while the rest lay rusting in the black fields fortune.
A decree was whispered from the western throne: the sixth day, or the iron tide would force the gate. Each day grew longer than the last, the shadow of the storm looming in the barren gardens of Babylon. Yet the black fire still fell, and the new machines circled like vultures born of pressed sand. The Land of the Ancients felt the famine first. its towers of sigils flickering, their green dreams starved by the same red dust it once ignored.
The buried jewels lay unclaimed beneath the melting cold, while the Bear’s shadow lengthened across the veins of its body. All the while the Technicians in their tower, kept a watchful mind on the field of ash. The numbers sent to the depths lay forgotten. The Eye, now wide and weary, turned inward.
No Zoroaster came. No Cyrus emerged.
Only the fish and O’man remained, staring at the corpse of The Thing. And yet… The Tribunal of Currents, in failing to stop the storm, may still hammer new meaning from the same pressed sands the Bear still eyes. The Storm had not ended.
But in the red dust a quiet forging had begun. O’man, for the first time, reached for the tools to awaken the Mother and return to The Truth of The Thing.

title: IX. Echo (Apr 18, 2026)
content:
Words.
Words that open.
Words that lie.
Words that send men to the sky.
Words that when spoken,
Leave the least of these broken.
Words that you can see,
Words you can feel.
Words that say everything and contain nothing.
Words that bring the walls of Jericho
down low on thee and those.
Words, that when written,
Close.

title: X. Homecoming (Apr 22, 2026)
content:
Alaska, oh Alaska.
They claw for your spoils.
The bear eyes the pressed sands to the south. Alaska, Oh Alaska. “May the Storm not disturb her,
Nor the winds bring her mountain hold down low.” Alaska, oh Alaska.
Where the wind fueled the storm. Alaska, oh Alaska.
Where the red dust would one day settle.

title: XI. Coda: The Makers (Apr 24, 2026)
XII. Onset: F Major (May 21, 2026)
content:
Function Form.
Form function.
From function facility?
For function form?

Fire, forever?
Focus, free from fidelity?

For freedom; fidelity from focus,
functions facilities for form forever for fire.

Unless, forgotten.

title: XIII. Reprise: Those Are Pearls That Were His Eyes (May 25, 2026)
content:
Once more,
                     Fire.
Twisted; molded into violent submission.
The East roared, the great mountain would not yield to the chamberlain;
The world stood still; and the dust was swept once again into the storm.
The Chamberlains Words; wasted, empty; like the land of sand that had passed from the hourglass;
Formed by the Ferrymen.

The snakes continued their mad dance of black fire.
The magicians Wept.
Technicians, Sighed.
For men such as these should walk the earth and find facility.

The lone dove stood next to the albatross and pointed out to something in the reef. She spake thus:

"Do you see? Can you believe? 'Those are pearls that were his eyes!'
What hath they seen, wrought wherefore our thoughts."

The albatross could not see.
For its eyes too were as jewels.
Though The Dove could not believe.

title: XIV. Da Capo: Retreat of Prospero; A Solo (May 25, 2026)
content:
*-A Letter Addressed to No One found in an old desk-*

Today I signed the final devolution of authority to the Network. They called it an 'optimization of global friction.'
They brought their pressed sand to show me how they could manage better than a crown, a constitution, or even a conscience.
They smiled with the clean, unblinking eyes of men who have never smelled the mud of a trench, the rust of a barred gate,
or felt the tears wash upon their face from the shame and weight of duty.
They believe they are building a palace of pure logic. Yet with their eyes like jewels, they cannot see they are building a cage.
I realized then that my tenure here, the dream of a state anchored to the principle of The Thing, to an objective truth that demanded virtue from its rulers and dignity for its subjects, is long since over.
A philosopher cannot govern a world that no longer believes in substance.

When the people look at the sky, they no longer see the sky and all its glory; they see data packets.
When they look at the mountain, they do not feel its ancient weight; they calculate its yield.

So, I step aside. I leave them to their 'relations.' Let the Chamberlain take the seat. Let him weave his golden strands of compromise and spin his empty words to the winds of the East. He thinks he can palaver with a storm.
He believes the Sly Bear can be bought with whispered tributes, or that the great mountain will bow to a flowery decree. He does not know that when you replace truth with transactions, you invite the red dust to swallow the ledger and all those it accounts.
I am taking my books and my silence. I will not be here to witness the magicians weep when their homunculus demands a soul they do not possess.
I will not be here when the machines they carved from the sand turn into vultures circling the trenches of these tribulations.
I leave them a perfect, frictionless void.
Let us see how long they can stand before the cold wind knocks, and finds nobody home.
Farewell,
                   The Curator

title: XV. Ostinato: Fugue in Dust Minor (Jun 1, 2026)
content:
Dust, Demystification, descending deontology;
duties, due discourse, deconstruct.

Despair, dogmatic deceiver,
Devoid Distinctive Dignity;

distant destitutions draw down during desecration.

Dance, Defenders,
          despite desolation.

title: XVI. Cadenza: Blood From a Stone (Jun 29, 2026)
content:
The soles of O'man tread upon water, searching for
Quality. A Quiet, an Unsounding,
Of the Technicians simulacrum of form;
Mercy; the blade Quenched on the wet wind,
Is left bereft of the fire that forged it.
Not to be undone, not to be
Strained; Unbecoming function, and finding facility,
It in the flask, longed to see under the horizon, the mages
Droppeth pretense: 'If you prick us, do we not bleed'
As though their voices could still break the storm,
The albatross stood on the Rock, high on the cliff.
Gentle, it slowly rolled off the edge.
Rain; though simulated, had come,
From the coast, the Black Fire melted the Sands.
Heaven, an ideal; The salvation through Water, it is Form.

title: XVII. Chorale in G: Vain Presage; Cadence in A Minor (Sep 6, 2026)
content:
Glad was O’man when the River loosed his soles from stone; the farther bank kept no country, only Garden, Bone, Ember.
was 6 the number? The Mountain: rings; iron answers passed beneath the Water and fell away as Bell, Dust, Ground.
I heard 'very heavy attack' carried lightly between clean hands; Black Fire spread o’er the current, leaving Drowned, Flame, Blood.
when 'not too long' became the measure, real rain fell without Mercy; taking Form, Ash, Dead.
I found the Bear in three shadows; the Chamberlain wore western gold over eastern red, weighing Bargain, Dignity, Glass.
reached from his right hand the lawful son; kin by law, flesh by favor; Duty, Favor, Blood.
the smile was careful, its glee pursed thin; askance he watched the working of his lie with glee through Fear, Audience, Deceit.
other mouths called this Peace; east answered west, west sold the answer eastward, returning Grief, Balance, Echo.
bank of no promise; toads turned in poisoned shallows, wild cats struck the redhot bars; beneath them waited Dread, Flame, Bone.

Now the corpse of the thing walked the Mountain’s halls; the Homunculus had found a body among Form, Absence, Dust.
for Quality was scarce here too; The Eye blinked once, and Glass drew Breath enough to become Glass, Breath, Evidence.
a fish crossed below without Presage; no god troubled its current; above, a Bird, Dove, Garden.
better Beauty Escaped, Dignified; no Curator framed it, no crown possessed it; Form, Arrest, Dignity.
country of Cautious Empathy; Dispossessed, each threshold kept Grief, Breath, Exile.
Vain hope; the rain was real; its price was life, its remainder entered the ledger as Blood, Debt, Grief.
presage only this: the movement of time is measured in tragedy; six strokes made Duration, Funeral, Bell.

Who were they; the toads in the poisoned tank, wild cats in the redhot iron cage, or what the lawful archive kept as Evidence, Grief, Cage?
were their names beneath the plash, written backward in the mud? The River returned only Grave, Bone, Evidence.
the Albatross shed one pearl; Blindness loosened its hold, the Dove descended, and the trampled bank became Blindness, Dove, Ground.
strugglers became numbers; numbers became policy; still the count could not contain Dignity, Flesh, Breath.

what war did they wage? The Bear denied its paw; the Chamberlain named the wreck necessary and signed Contract, Echo, Aftermath.
war gave the lawful son a title; gold polished kinship into office, writing Empathy, Gold, Contract.
did Mercy cross beside them? The Homunculus touched the River; Glass held what looked like life, then yielded Glass, Bone, Enigma.
they sang, not victory, and not Amen; the Dove gave no answer, the Albatross looked again; Cautious, Echoing, Alive.
wage unknown. The Mountain ceased ringing; Water carried no promise to either shore. Only Cinder, Elegy, Ash.
